summary: Master the art of budgeting for NGOs with our specialized training course. Gain practical insights into budget preparation and execution for successful projects
lede: Budget Preparation and Execution for NGOs provides a practical system for planning, allocating, monitoring, and adjusting restricted and unrestricted funds. It helps you build defensible budgets, align spending with programme priorities, and keep donor conditions visible throughout execution. Through hands-on exercises, you will work with budget structures, burn-rate calculations, variance trackers, donor allocation logic, and Excel-based monitoring templates. You will also explore scenario planning for currency volatility and automated reporting workflows, helping you control spending, reconcile plans with field realities, and report financial performance with confidence.
audienceIntro: This course is built for NGO professionals who prepare, review, execute, or report budgets in donor-funded environments. It is suitable for people who already handle budget inputs or execution data and need stronger control, reporting, and planning discipline.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in NGO finance, project accounting, grants management, programme management, or budgeting support. A solid grasp of basic accounting concepts, spreadsheet use in Excel, and familiarity with donor-funded projects will help you complete the practical exercises successfully. No programming is required, but you should be ready to work with budget templates, variance trackers, and donor reporting formats.
